```{css, echo=FALSE}

body {
  font-family: "Sofia Pro";
}

.intro {
max-width: 640px;
margin: 40px 0px;
}

.report-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 24px;
  max-width: 640px;
  margin: 30px 0;
}

.report-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 24px;
}

.report-row img {
  width: 163px;
  height: 211px;
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: 10px;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  background: #cfe3ea; /* shows if the image is missing */
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.report-text {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 25px;
}

.report-title {
  font-size: 1.3em;
}

.report-btn {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 16px 34px;
  font-size: 1.15em;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #47807C, #74BDB8);
  border-radius: 50px;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 10px #2a4D4a;
  transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}

.report-btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 16px #2a4D4a;
  color: #ffffff !important;
}

@media (max-width: 500px) {
  .report-row { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
  .report-row img { width: 100%; height: 500px; }
}
```
